description: School with 3 floors, each floor has 8 classrooms of 40 students off a corridor, stairs at both ends, two exits on the ground floor.

spec.name: School
assumptions: Each classroom is 6m x 5m with corridor width 2m.
Ground floor is level 0 with two street-level exits.
Stairs are 1.2m wide at both ends of the corridor.
Exit width 1.8m assumed for school doors.
Building depth allows for corridor and two rows of classrooms.
